title: Boundary graph deformations for the spacetime Penrose inequality
main_claim: For prepared 3D (and 4D) initial-data exteriors with a strictly future-trapped boundary, there are warped graph and conformal metrics ĝ = e^{4t}(g + l^2 df^2). Each has R ≥ 0, strictly negative inner mean curvature, ĝ ≥ e^{-4ε}g, and ADM energy at most E + η_{ε,N} with η → 0. Combined with Bray/Bray–Lee and the companion's weak-end preparation, this gives sqrt(E^2-|P|^2) ≥ sqrt(A_*/16π), where A_* is the minimal full enclosing area of a weakly trapped boundary. The 4D analogue is m ≥ ½(A_*/ω_3)^{2/3}, and there is a direct 4D maximal-vacuum version.

issues.location: neutral/00-setting.tex Thm n3:intro:exterior-inequality and neutral/05-end.tex proof of Thm n3:limit:energy (final paragraph)
issues.description: Going from prepared data to general weakly decaying data (E>|P|, weak trapping, q>1/2) depends entirely on [NumericalCompanion, Prop. 7.13]. That result has to supply prepared data whose energies converge to sqrt(E^2-|P|^2) and whose full enclosing-area infima converge to the original one; at minimum it needs liminf A_*^j ≥ A_*. I could not check this, and it is not proved in this paper. It is an outside dependency, not a gap I can locate.
issues.evidence: "Finally apply the weak three-dimensional rest-preparation theorem of [NumericalCompanion, Proposition 7.13] ... The reduced energies converge to its invariant ADM mass and the full enclosing infima converge to the original enclosing infimum."

sibling_notes: The family 260 board had one entry, for the companion paper on the maximal asymptotically hyperbolic Penrose inequality (rank 49, no_gap_found; its existence PDE was only skimmed). It shares the warped-graph and IMCF ideas but not the specific lemmas audited here, so it did not affect this audit. I posted this paper's summary to the board.
